world.title: world gate
world.ok: world gate: OK (line `%(line_name)s`: container `%(container)s`, site `%(site)s`, %(count)d stamps reconciled)
world.off: world gate: not configured (REFLECT_WORLD unset and the default world.json is absent) ⇒ this gate is off (pluggable module; a single-line repo neither gains nor loses — one world = current behaviour. To enable: cp zreflect/world.json.example world.json)
world.knob_file_missing: REFLECT_WORLD is set but the declaration file is absent — write the declaration first (or drop the knob)
world.spec_broken: world declaration %(name)s is unreadable / not valid JSON: %(error)s
world.spec_shape_bad: world declaration %(name)s has a bad shape: an object {lines, active, stamps} is required
world.spec_not_object: world declaration is not an object — bad shape (an object {lines, active, stamps} is required)
world.lines_empty: world line list is empty or not an object — an empty list is not a pass (zero-value guard): a list must exist for a reason
world.active_missing: missing active (required: which line counts as current is a human decision, but the decision must be written down — not writing it = everyone guesses)
world.active_unknown: active=`%(active)s` is not in the list (known lines: %(lines)s)
world.line_missing_field: line `%(line_name)s` is missing field `%(field)s` (the required four: %(fields)s)
world.override_unknown: REFLECT_WORLD_LINE=%(line_name)s is not in the list — the override points at a line that does not exist (write it correctly or drop the knob)
world.branch_mismatch: current branch `%(branch)s` is a line in the list, but active declares `%(active)s` — the switch script did not run (or active was not updated): the world this gate is validating right now belongs to another line
world.stamps_empty: stamp list is empty or not an object — a world declaration without stamps cannot hold a line switch together (zero-value guard): the three switching steps need a witness
world.stamp_missing_value: stamp `%(name)s` is missing value (required: one measured sample written by the switch script)
world.stamp_missing_cmd: stamp `%(name)s` is missing cmd (required: the replay command that reconciles it — a stamp without cmd is prose)
world.stamp_timeout: stamp `%(name)s` reconciliation **timed out**: `%(command)s` — a command wired into pre-commit must not wait forever
world.stamp_command_failed: stamp `%(name)s` reconciliation command failed (rc=%(return_code)s): `%(command)s` — the reconciliation method itself is dead
world.stamp_mismatch: stamp `%(name)s` mismatch: environment=%(actual)s vs declared=%(expected)s — declaration and environment disagree (the environment did not follow the switch, or it is polluted by another line); fix by re-running the switch script
